additional_concerns: node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offering in Scope; an unoffered component returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than FALSE. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5, node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 similarly place promotional conditions in Scope. These domain restrictions need reconciliation with questions permitting a negative prohibition answer or selected-control compliance answer.

The two offer-level candidates combine offer-level promotion with an existential gift component. They need to establish that the same non-discount gift component has the relevant promotional connection; otherwise unrelated components could jointly trigger prohibition.

The circular defines distributors in the context of SFC-authorised funds, while its paragraph 3.11 summary uses broader investment-product language. Fund-specific predicates are supported as contextual restrictions, not as an exhaustive statement of the Code's coverage.

The external Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and FAQ question 1 dated 30 September 2010 are absent, with no supplied dependency IDs. They are needed to verify gift classifications and interpretations extending beyond the circular's express summary. Footnotes identify these authorities but do not supply their contents.

The full SFO section 103 and particular authorisation or exemption provisions are absent. They would be needed to apply a statutory exception, although the circular directly supports the narrow descriptive exception claim assessed here.

node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b expressly treats funding and fulfilment as unnecessary once offering is attributed to the distributor. The source makes offering the trigger but does not resolve disputed attribution in third-party arrangements; the supplied classification must not assume that resolution.

A FALSE gift-prohibition result or TRUE selected-gift-control result does not establish compliance with section 103 or advertising requirements. The source does not automatically classify every guaranteed return or incentive as a gift.
The supplied source contains no operative date interval. The candidates' temporal-basis wording and UNKNOWN handling do not establish which legal version applies.
